subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When a lock is requested, the system shall compute readiness against the mainline the lock will land on.
rationale: The second draft to lock must see what the first locked, and the mainline admits merges checked against an older state (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-22, brainstorm:feature-draft#F-15)
fit_criterion: A fixture draft whose readiness passed before another draft locked a conflicting change is refused at its own lock and passes once revised; zero locks are accepted on a readiness result computed against an older mainline.
